column7: 2026-11-05: Decimal-units spike (parse(str,{decimal:true}), powers of 1000) reverted; product undecided whether it goes in parse() or a new function. Finding: float multiply gives off-by-one on exact values ('2.01 kB'->2009, '4.1 MB'->4099999); needs decimal string scaling, not x*1000 then floor.

2026-11-05: Decided 2026-11-05: decimal units ship in parse() as bytes.parse(v,{decimal:true}) (kB/MB/GB/TB/PB = powers of 1000, fractional bytes floored; default unchanged). Implemented via decimal string scaling (parseDecimal), not float multiply, which gave off-by-one (2.01 kB->2009). Supersedes the earlier 'undecided' spike note.
